periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward and anterior tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical axis is notably longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch exhibits a clear downward tapering, with the bulk of the area concentrated above the lowest point.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick; the band occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is roughly equivalent to 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow discoloration or soil staining on the white fur of the posterior flanks and lower back.
